presets.name: Standard (Meshtastic default)
presets.summary: LongFast — the worldwide default. Works everywhere; best choice when your area has no organized mesh.

presets.name: Bay Area Mesh
presets.summary: MediumFast, slot 45, hop limit 6 (personal node) — bayme.sh recommended settings (updated Oct 2025). Suggested role: Client, or Client Mute in a vehicle.

presets.name: NYC Mesh (NYME.SH)
presets.summary: MediumSlow, slot 48, hop limit 7 (personal node) — nyme.sh recommended settings. Suggested role: Client Mute for handhelds, Client if stationary.

presets.name: NYC Mesh — Legacy (LongFast)
presets.summary: LongFast, slot 20 — nyme.sh legacy network. Often busier until the MediumSlow migration completes; use it to compare traffic.

presets.name: Puget Sound (Seattle)
presets.summary: LongFast, slot 20, hop limit 3 — pugetmesh.org standard settings (they trial others seasonally; LongFast is the year-round baseline). Suggested role: Client Mute for portables.

presets.name: Greater Boston Mesh
presets.summary: LongFast defaults — bostonme.sh runs the standard preset with no custom channel.

presets.name: Mountain Mesh (N. Georgia / E. Tennessee)
presets.summary: MediumFast, slot 45, hop limit 5 — mtnme.sh settings since their Oct 2025 migration off LongFast.

presets.name: Freq51 (Utah)
presets.summary: MediumFast, slot 51, hop limit 7 — freq51.net community settings (Salt Lake area). Suggested role: Client Mute for mobile nodes.

presets.name: Austin Mesh
presets.summary: LongFast defaults, slot untouched — austinmesh.org's Meshtastic settings (their custom work went into MeshCore; Meshtastic runs stock).
